lines.text: R{sc:omae} MDCCCXCIX. — Excudebat C. D{sc:e} L{sc:uigi.}
lines.plain: Romae MDCCCXCIX. — Excudebat C. De Luigi.

observations: The page is blank but for the rule at its foot (104.8-528.1 pt, at 710.5 pt) and the imprint under it. The rule is printed in short broken pieces at its left end, from 104.8 to 237.6 pt, and whole from 238.3 pt on; it is drawn as one rule. L01: «Romae» and «De Luigi» in capitals and small capitals; the line is scaled to the box of the printed line.
The perforated library stamp of the title page shows through on this page, reversed (at 568-645 pt); it is not transcribed.
